name: Orthology methods benchmark using phylogenetic patterns
description: An evaluation framework that assesses orthology inference methods by comparing their predictions against phylogenetic patterns defined at the base of eukaryotes.
reputation: Recognized in comparative genomics and bioinformatics circles for benchmarking orthology inference methods, though adoption is specialized to the field.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; sensitive to species sampling and gene-tree/species-tree discordance, potential annotation contamination; results depend heavily on dataset composition and evolutionary depth.
